draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 216th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 27th of 30 at LB. He went 153rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (216th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 91 tackles in 2022, 9th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 33 career games and 16 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (7 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 10 (97th percentile), sacks 3.0 (91st percentile), passes defended 5 (85th percentile). Weak spots: passer rating allowed 122.0 (6th percentile), missed tackle rate 12.9% (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 101 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
